# Blue Hour jazz posters and date-edit continuation

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Two initial poster variants and two date edits form one work. Both date edits use the Flare original, as stated in image alt text; the Sunburst initial poster is not their input. The event is a synthetic design example, not a verified event. Exact generation and edit prompts remain linked at the source. Cited CellCog API timings and older DEV 2.5 tests are not these works. Source files are 1000-pixel WebP editorial exports, not claimed raw 1536-pixel generation files.
